info.title: dotnet-package-skills
info.description: Copies agent skills bundled inside NuGet packages from the NuGet global-packages directory into a repository's skills directory, where coding agents can actually find them.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Copies agent skills bundled inside NuGet packages into a folder your coding agent reads.

Package authors ship skills at skills/<package-id>-<skill-name>/SKILL.md inside the package. Restore extracts them to the NuGet global-packages directory, which is outside your repository and which no coding agent scans. This tool bridges that gap.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Copy skills bundled in NuGet packages into the repository.

options.name: --target
options.description: Solution or project to inspect, or to resolve untracked bare package IDs. Defaults to searching the current directory.

options.name: --package
options.description: Take skills from Id or Id@Version (for example Mockly@1.10.0). A bare Id uses the destination manifest first, then --target or an auto-detected target. Repeatable. Floating versions are not accepted.

options.name: --destination
options.description: Folder to copy skills into. Default: .agents/skills [default: .agents/skills]

options.name: --global-packages
options.description: Override the NuGet global-packages directory instead of asking the CLI. Relative paths resolve from the invocation directory.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would change without writing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Choose which skills to add, with descriptions, one page at a time. Only skills that aren't installed are listed; installed skills are left as they are. [default: False]

commands.name: list
commands.description: Show which packages ship skills, without copying anything.

options.name: --target
options.description: Solution or project to inspect, or to resolve untracked bare package IDs. Defaults to searching the current directory.

options.name: --package
options.description: Take skills from Id or Id@Version (for example Mockly@1.10.0). A bare Id uses the destination manifest first, then --target or an auto-detected target. Repeatable. Floating versions are not accepted.

options.name: --destination
options.description: Folder to copy skills into. Default: .agents/skills [default: .agents/skills]

options.name: --global-packages
options.description: Override the NuGet global-packages directory instead of asking the CLI. Relative paths resolve from the invocation directory.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove skills this tool previously copied in.

options.name: --destination
options.description: Folder to remove skills from. Default: .agents/skills [default: .agents/skills]

options.name: --package
options.description: Remove only this package's skills. Accepts Id, or Id@Version to remove them only if that version is the one installed.

options.name: --stale
options.description: Remove only stale skills: skills whose package the target no longer references, or references at a different version. Reads the target's package references, so it needs a solution or project. [default: False]

options.name: --target
options.description: With --stale, the solution or project to compare against. Defaults to searching the current directory.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would change without writing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Choose which installed skills to remove, with descriptions, one page at a time. Only skills this tool installed are listed. [default: False]
